## What's Changed
* 新增追漫与章节更新通知 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/10
* 新增章节下载任务管理 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/11
* 调整发现页搜索和插件导航并新增稍后阅读 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/12
* 补齐 Core 本地化目录更新 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/14
* 补齐 Core 本地化目录更新 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/13
* 优化宽屏双页阅读和稍后阅读入口 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/15
* 准备 Willow 1.2.0 发布 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/16
* 发布 Willow 1.2.0 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/17


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intitni/Willow/compare/version/1.1.0...version/1.2.0
